fields.v: Chondamrongkul, N., Rueangsirarak, W., Jakkaew, P. (2026). Evolution Context Gap: An Empirical Study of Agent Manifests. In 2026 23rd International Joint Conference on Computer Science and Software Engineering (JCSSE), IEEE, pp. 369-374. doi:10.1109/JCSSE68839.2026.11597070
Conference — 2026 23rd International Joint Conference on Computer Science and Software Engineering (JCSSE), IEEE, pp. 369-374
School of Applied Digital Technology, Mae Fah Luang University, Chiang Rai, Thailand (all three authors)

Evaluates — repository mining: content analysis of 80 real-world agent manifests (CLAUDE.md, AGENTS.md, Copilot, Cline) from public GitHub repositories, what they contain and omit (especially evolution context); also contributes a six-category content taxonomy and, in the discussion, a minimal four-item evolution-context template
fields.why: The author's rule of 2026-11-23 settles this case: descriptive studies that mine context files such as CLAUDE.md or AGENTS.md from repositories are 'Evaluates — repository mining'. r2 left the nature uncertain and lacked the 'repository mining' label. The four-item template (p. 5) is a short discussion suggestion, not a proposed and specified approach, so no secondary nature is added

fields.v: Agent manifests (developer-authored instruction/context files): CLAUDE.md (Claude Code), AGENTS.md (OpenAI Codex), .github/copilot-instructions.md (GitHub Copilot), .cursorrules (Cursor), .clinerules, .windsurfrules; no versions

Automatic: GitHub code search API (14 queries), regex section segmentation, three-model LLM classifier (Llama-3.3-70B, Nemotron-Super-49B, Mixtral-8x22B via NVIDIA NIM free tier, temperature 0, JSON output, majority vote >=2/3); keyword search for Lehman terms. N/A. Descriptive: Workflow & Process present in 96.2% (mean fraction 43.5%), Coding Style 87.5% (39.3%), Project Structure 87.5% (37.6%), Architecture 82.5% (29.9%), Agent Rules 56.2% (8.0%), Evolution Context 26.2% (2.3%). 73.8% contain no evolution content; 0% mention Lehman's laws; Phase 13.8%, Tech debt 12.5%, Refactoring plans 10%, Complexity trend 6.2%, Churn 5.0%. Evolution presence by type: CLAUDE.md 28.3%, Copilot 33.3%, AGENTS.md 19.0% ('statistically indistinguishable'). Only Coding Style vs law conformance rho=0.431, p=0.040 (n=23); not significant after Bonferroni
N/A

Taxonomy boundary (Architecture vs Evolution) could shift estimates; larger human-annotated benchmark for the classifier planned; >=30 stars over-represents well-maintained projects; CLAUDE.md dominates (57.5%); RQ3 n=23 underpowered (~45% power), all correlations non-significant after Bonferroni, exploratory. Cultural explanation of the gap needs qualitative evidence. Future: corpus n=200+, longitudinal tracking of manifests, controlled experiments on downstream agent decision quality with/without evolution context; manifest linters, enrichment tooling, templates

Printed page numbers 369-374 = PDF pages 1-6. Table II and Table III came out jumbled; Table II rebuilt from text and Fig. 1 (counts/percentages/fractions in matching order); Table III appears to be extracted column by column (one line per variable: Age, Stars, Cmts, Phase, Law, A.R.), consistent with Coding Style x Law = .43*, but only that pair (from text) was used. Inconsistencies: abstract and related work say 'five' agent/manifest types, contributions and conclusion say 'four manifest types', queries targeted six types; corpus has four types. Inclusion criterion is >=6 months since creation, but corpus age range is reported as 5-179 months. Fig. 4 caption says low-conformance projects are <=0.25, text says <=0.5. Discussion calls the rho=0.431 correlation 'significant' after stating it does not survive Bonferroni. Ref. [9] (253 CLAUDE.md files) is attributed to 'Ramaswamy et al.', arXiv:2506.01784. Inter-model and human kappas given only as thresholds ('> 0.65', '> 0.75'). How the 23 repositories' Lehman phase and law conformance were obtained ('population metadata') not explained. Replication package: https://github.com/cnacha-mfu/seo-replication/tree/jcsse2026 (corpus, classifier, scripts). No pre-registration. Languages: TypeScript, Python, C#, Rust, Go

Judgement call between Yes and Partly
fields.doubt: A secção VI trata a correlação ρ=0,431 como exploratória, mas o resumo e a discussão chamam-lhe significativa. Decide se esta incoerência baixa Q9 para Partly ou se mantém Yes.
